series.title: Sunrun and Tesla deliver record 580MW to California grid amid heatwave
series.summary: Residential battery energy storage systems (BESS) across California discharged more than 580MW of peak power to the state's grid on the evening of 9 September 2026 via a Tesla-Sunrun VPP.

series.title: 21GWh BESS deployed globally in August: One-fifth in Saudi Arabia, European activity soars
series.summary: Nearly 21GWh of grid-scale BESS came online globally last month, of which around a fifth was in Saudi Arabia while the majority was in China.

series.title: Australia’s Victoria requires new data centres to bring their own renewable energy and storage
series.summary: Australia's Victoria mandates new data centres match demand with own renewable energy and battery storage under new rules.

series.title: CATL to supply 918MWh Romania BESS, another 500MWh of projects progress elsewhere in CEE
series.summary: A flurry of project completions, financings and supplier deals for large-scale BESS across the Central and Eastern Europe (CEE) region, from Greenvolt, Renovatio & CATL, Eurowind, Renalfa, MOL Group, Tavion, MetaWealth and Enexus & Longi.

series.title: Compressed air energy storage (CAES): yet to deliver on promises, can A-CAES go one step further?
series.summary: Compressed air energy storage (CAES) holds much promise for large-scale, LDES, but has struggled to get off the ground outside of China.

series.title: UK regulator looks to cut down BESS interconnection backlog with extra financial commitment
series.summary: UK energy industry regulator Ofgem said it is minded to approve the introduction of a financial commitment for BESS in an attempt to reduce the oversupply of the projects awaiting a grid connection.

series.title: GridStor closes US$220 million financing for 400MWh Arizona BESS
series.summary: GridStor, a US-based developer and operator of grid-scale battery energy storage systems (BESS) has closed a US$220 million financing agreement for the 100MW/400MWh White Tank project in Arizona, US.

series.title: How transferability and US-China tensions are transforming US BESS and renewables financing
series.summary: Energy-Storage.news speaks with Nathan Picarsic, co-founder of Horizon Advisory, at the 2026 US Battery Asset Management and Solar and Storage Finance Summits in Garden Grove, California.

series.title: FERC has options for modernizing PJM’s governance
series.summary: The commission’s jurisdiction over transmission governance allows it to modify filing-rights allocations and adjust the PJM Interconnection’s nominating committee, writes Harvard Law’s Ari Peskoe.

series.title: Developers Valent, Akaysha advance 550MW of NEM-connected BESS in Victoria, Australia
series.summary: Two Victorian battery storage projects have reached new construction and commissioning milestones this week, both connecting to the National Electricity Market (NEM) in Australia.

series.title: AGL submits 1.45GWh BESS to Australia’s EPBC Act, investigates 4GWh Bathurst Battery in New South Wales
series.summary: AGL has advanced two grid-scale BESS in New South Wales, one now before Australia's EPBC Act and the other still in early planning.

series.title: Nvidia selects three BESS solutions for new AI facilities qualification programme
series.summary: Nvidia’s new qualification programme for products and solutions that meet its reference design requirements includes three battery storage solutions.

series.title: EU Battery Passport will be an evolving tool rather than a one-off
series.summary: During the Battery & Energy Storage Tech Expo in Barcelona, Spain, Energy-storage.news spoke with Ken Davies, chief commercial officer at Digital Product Passport (DPP) provider DigiProd Pass and conference program director of the event, about the upcoming implementation of the EU Battery Passport.

series.title: Greenvolt starts building 2.4GWh, BYD-supplied Poland BESS; 900MWh progressed elsewhere in CEE/Baltics
series.summary: IPP Greenvolt Power has started building its Siedlce battery storage project in Poland, while Gore Street, Taaleri Energia and DS1 have moved to construction on projects in Poland, Estonia and Lithuania respectively.

series.title: NYSERDA picks eight projects for New York utility-scale energy storage programme
series.summary: Results are in for New York’s first solicitations for large-scale energy storage resources, with 950MW of bids selected by NYSERDA.

series.title: Data centre buildout uplifting US BESS market outlook, Wood Mackenzie says
series.summary: Market research firm Wood Mackenzie stated that data centre buildout is uplifting the US battery energy storage system (BESS) outlook across all segments.

series.title: ‘FCAs convinced regulators to compromise on grid fees in Germany’: Eco Stor’s Georg Gallmetzer on cementing the industry’s future
series.summary: We recently caught up with Georg Gallmetzer, managing director of German BESS platform Eco Stor, about the firm’s role in formulating flexible connection agreements (FCAs) and how this was intimately tied to the debate on grid fees.

series.title: On clean energy, bigger is not always better
series.summary: When Congress revisits clean-energy tax policy, lawmakers should restore incentives for locally driven solar and storage projects, writes Edward Yim at Lawyers for Good Government.

series.title: Advanced transmission projects get $1.9B in DOE funding
series.summary: The department expects the projects will add 23 GW in grid capacity and will come online in “record time” to improve the existing transmission system.

series.title: States sue Trump administration, developers over offshore wind lease buyouts
series.summary: Attorneys general from California and a coalition of Northeastern states accused the federal government of violating several laws and the developers of colluding with the administration.

series.title: AEMO connects record 9.1GW of renewables and storage to Australia’s NEM in FY26, warns reliability depends on timely investment
series.summary: AEMO has said that a record 9.1GW of new renewable energy and storage capacity connected to the National Electricity Market (NEM) in FY26.

series.title: ESR to acquire Aquila Clean Energy APAC in Asia-Pacific renewables and energy storage consolidation
series.summary: ESR, a Singapore-headquartered real asset owner and manager focused on logistics real estate and data centres, has signed an agreement to acquire 100% of Aquila Clean Energy APAC.

series.title: US ROUNDUP: BESS portfolio deals, investment and partnerships for Energy Vault, SMT Energy, NeoVolta and SK On
series.summary: Recently, US BESS companies Energy Vault and Goshe, SMT Energy and Climate Adaptive Infrastructure, and NeoVolta and SK On have made major deals and secured strategic partnerships.

series.summary: South Korean researchers have recovered high-purity silver from end-of-life silicon solar panels and used it to produce electrocatalysts for converting carbon dioxide into carbon monoxide. series.summary: Another roundup of user-posted hot takes and analysis from the energy storage industry recently.

series.title: FERC rejects Oklo complaint seeking to reinstate project to PJM’s interconnection study cycle
series.summary: The decision affects a 750-MW, mixed technology project in Virginia, which Oklo said would be delayed by at least 18 months if it misses the current interconnection cycle.

series.title: Second federal judge overturns $7B Solar for All cancellation
series.summary: The decision in a suit brought by Harris County, Texas, follows a similar ruling last week. A Harris County judge called it “a really important victory for energy resilience.”
